resources.string: Where do you want to connect?
Choose a country. MOST will try its available connections and keep the selected exit country.
Connections from the subscription where you chose this country.
If a connection fails, MOST tries another profile for the same country. The last working profile is remembered.
Selecting a specific profile switches to manual mode. Country automation is disabled.
No country groups are available here. Open all connections or refresh the subscription.
No working connection is available for the selected country. Retry, refresh the subscription or change network.
Could not start this profile. Select another connection or refresh the subscription.
The network is available, but access through this server failed. Retry or select another connection.
No network connection. Enable Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Internet access through VPN is unavailable. Check the network or select another connection.
The exit was detected in another country. MOST is looking for a matching connection.
Direct: VPN connects to the server directly. Bridge: VPN connects through Moscow.
